announcements.headline: Related Party Transactions and Portfolio Update
announcements.insight: BWA Group provides a portfolio update following its October acquisition of an Aracari interest. This follows recent insider buying by the CEO and MD.

announcements.headline: Aracari: 51% Interest and Permit Applications
announcements.insight: BWA Group plc acquires a 51% interest in Aracari and applies for permits. This follows recent insider buying by the CEO and MD.

announcements.headline: Purchase of Shares by Managing Director
announcements.insight: Managing Director purchases shares following the CEO’s earlier buy. This signals internal confidence in the business.

announcements.headline: Purchase of Shares by Chief Executive Officer
announcements.insight: The CEO purchased shares following the June operations update. This insider buying may signal confidence in recent operational performance.

announcements.headline: Results of Magnetometry and Operations Update
announcements.insight: BWA Group plc has released results of magnetometry and an operations update. This scheduled filing provides initial performance data for shareholders to assess progress.
